gaps.sentence: The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.

gaps.sentence: She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.

gaps.explanation: 'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.

gaps.explanation: The subject is 'botany'; a specialist is a 'botanist'.

gaps.sentence: A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.
